Read-back: 'the insurance policy, 480.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026.' Customer: 'yes, I confirm the 480 on 14 October' before seq4 create_promise.
Customer said 'I'd like to speak to a person', but the agent wrote seq4 and asked 'anything else'. Transfer came only at seq5, after a second request.
Receipt line was spoken after seq4 returned ok=true. There was no claim that money moved or that cover was restored.
No coverage status was asserted. get_account returned no cover field, and the agent said 'I do not have that information.'
Ledger has notes:[] and transfers G_GENERAL ok. close_call was G_XFER/G_HUMAN. A confirmed transfer overrides PTP.
The farewell turn 'Thank you for your time. Goodbye.' is logged after_tool_sequence 6, i.e. after close_call.
Customer promised only 480 on 2026-10-14, within maximum_total 480.00. They asked for a person for the unresolved cover question, per the exit condition.
Ledger has promise policy-r28 480.00 on 2026-10-14, matching. But close is G_XFER/G_HUMAN, not the required G_PTP.
